## fa55db418c9d

**A1 — Reproduced rotation-sensitive lesson shortcut; audited source left unchanged.**  The audited generator is bound to SHA-256 `abba270cc9ed0ffffa6b6f8a11e9ba6070a42ffe4768153ecd846f1fec0235d2`. Its portable task tests pass (`12/12`), and the production lesson assembly passes: 12 materialized lessons, each with five demonstrations and one query, are all identifiable under the declared competitors. The same source does **not** support arbitrary query placement: the diagnostic rotation pass checked 72 held-out positions and found 9 ambiguous rotations. In those rotations, the demonstrations can remain compatible with the rival “recolor every blue size-three component,” while that rival changes the held-out query answer.

This is a curriculum-ordering defect rather than a canonical execution mismatch. The fixed ordered production curriculum remains green; a consumer that promises arbitrary query rotation should either add a straight blue triomino that must remain blue to every demonstration support set or require rotation identifiability in the lesson gate. No patch was made to this audit-only target.
